observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Indoor stage with a decorated backdrop featuring indigenous patterns and large masks, bright stage lighting, smoke effects, and an audience seated at tables.
observation.dancers: Group of mixed adult male and female dancers, plus a central lead figure in elaborate costume and a toddler held during a scene.
observation.formation_and_space: Dynamic group formations including lines, staggered rows, and circular movement across the stage floor.
observation.posture: Upright torso with energetic posture, knees frequently bent for leaps and low stances.
observation.footwork: High-energy jumping, high kicks, quick marching, and leaping on the beat; exact contact points obscured by fast movement and camera work.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms swing, raise, and hold props such as spears, sticks, and drums.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso leans and twists dynamically with leaps and turns; hips move naturally with the vigorous stepping.
observation.partnering: Mostly solo and group unison dancing, with brief moments of individual interaction and holding a child.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent high leaps, jumps, drops to one knee on the floor, and spinning turns.
observation.costume_and_props: Elaborate feathered headdresses, animal print trims, bright colorful fringe, headwear with large feathers, skirts, boots with fuzzy cuffs; holding spears and drums.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement and weight transfer cannot be determined due to rapid movement and stage smoke effects.

signature_moments.what: Dancers enter the stage from the sides in a fast, leaping sprint while holding spears.
Dancers execute high vertical leaps with legs tucked, landing sharply on the beat.
Dancers drop simultaneously to one knee on the floor holding spears upward.
